name.zh: 法拉第发现电磁感应的实验
name.en: Faraday’s discovery of electromagnetic induction

textbookTitle.zh: 法拉第发现电磁感应的实验
textbookTitle.en: Faraday’s discovery of electromagnetic induction

goal.zh: 认识实验推动电磁感应规律形成；此处仅历史提及。
goal.en: Recognize the role of experiments in discovering induction; this passage is a historical mention.

name.zh: 练习使用打点计时器
name.en: Practise using a ticker timer

textbookTitle.zh: 练习使用打点计时器
textbookTitle.en: Practise using a ticker timer

goal.zh: 通过固定打点周期把纸带上的点对应到时间和位移。
goal.en: Connect regularly timed dots with time intervals and displacement.

title.zh: 位置变化快慢的描述——速度
title.en: Describing the rate of position change: velocity

name.zh: 测量纸带的平均速度和瞬时速度
name.en: Measure average and instantaneous velocity from tape

textbookTitle.zh: 测量纸带的平均速度和瞬时速度
textbookTitle.en: Measure average and instantaneous velocity from tape

goal.zh: 手拉纸带，比较时间区间平均速度并缩小区间估计瞬时速度。
goal.en: Pull a tape, compare interval-average velocities, and narrow the interval to estimate instantaneous velocity.

title.zh: 位置变化快慢的描述——速度
title.en: Describing the rate of position change: velocity

name.zh: 借助传感器与计算机测速度
name.en: Measure velocity with sensors and a computer

textbookTitle.zh: 借助传感器与计算机测速度
textbookTitle.en: Measure velocity with sensors and a computer

goal.zh: 由超声传播时间求位移，再由连续位置信息求速度。
goal.en: Infer position from ultrasonic travel time, then velocity from consecutive positions.

title.zh: 匀变速直线运动的研究
实验：探究小车速度随时间变化的规律

name.zh: 探究小车速度随时间变化的规律
name.en: Investigate cart velocity over time

textbookTitle.zh: 探究小车速度随时间变化的规律
textbookTitle.en: Investigate cart velocity over time

goal.zh: 重物牵引小车，读纸带速度并用v-t图像判断速度如何变化。
goal.en: Use a pulled cart, ticker-tape velocities and a velocity–time graph to investigate acceleration.

title.zh: 匀变速直线运动的研究

name.zh: 比较纸片、纸团与橡皮下落的快慢
name.en: Compare the fall of flat paper, crumpled paper and an eraser

textbookTitle.zh: 比较纸片、纸团与橡皮下落的快慢
textbookTitle.en: Compare the fall of flat paper, crumpled paper and an eraser

goal.zh: 保持纸张质量不变而改变形状，避免把空气中的落速直接归因于质量。
goal.en: Change paper shape without changing its mass to separate drag from mass.

title.zh: 匀变速直线运动的研究

name.zh: 伽利略轻重两石捆绑的逻辑反证
name.en: Galileo’s tied-stones argument

textbookTitle.zh: 伽利略轻重两石捆绑的逻辑反证
textbookTitle.en: Galileo’s tied-stones argument

goal.zh: 把“重者落得快”假设用于捆绑物，识别相互矛盾的预测。
goal.en: Apply the heavier-falls-faster hypothesis to tied stones and expose contradictory predictions.

title.zh: 匀变速直线运动的研究

name.zh: 牛顿管实验
name.en: The Newton tube experiment

textbookTitle.zh: 轻重不同的物体下落快慢的研究
textbookTitle.en: The Newton tube experiment

goal.zh: 比较同一管中铁片和羽毛在抽气前后的下落。
goal.en: Compare the same iron piece and feather before and after removing air.

title.zh: 匀变速直线运动的研究

name.zh: 研究自由落体运动的规律
name.en: Investigate free fall with ticker tape

textbookTitle.zh: 研究自由落体运动的规律
textbookTitle.en: Investigate free fall with ticker tape

goal.zh: 由重物带动的纸带研究匀加速规律，比较不同质量下的加速度。
goal.en: Use falling-mass ticker tape to investigate acceleration and compare masses.

title.zh: 匀变速直线运动的研究

name.zh: 用手机测自由落体加速度
name.en: Measure free-fall acceleration with a phone

textbookTitle.zh: 用手机测自由落体加速度
textbookTitle.en: Measure free-fall acceleration with a phone

goal.zh: 辨认静止、自由下落、接住三个阶段，解释不同传感器输出的含义。
goal.en: Identify rest, free fall and catch while distinguishing raw and gravity-corrected acceleration.

title.zh: 匀变速直线运动的研究

name.zh: 伽利略斜面实验：研究自由落体运动
name.en: Galileo’s timed incline experiment

textbookTitle.zh: 伽利略对自由落体运动的研究
textbookTitle.en: Galileo’s timed incline experiment

goal.zh: 以斜面减慢下落，用铜球与滴水计时研究位移和时间关系，并讨论倾角外推。
goal.en: Slow motion on an incline, time a rolling ball with water, and discuss extrapolation toward free fall.

title.zh: 匀变速直线运动的研究

name.zh: 伽利略的望远镜天文观测
name.en: Galileo’s telescopic observations

textbookTitle.zh: 伽利略的望远镜天文观测
textbookTitle.en: Galileo’s telescopic observations

goal.zh: 认识望远镜观测如何提供天文学的证据。
goal.en: Recognize how telescopic observations supply astronomical evidence.

title.zh: 匀变速直线运动的研究

name.zh: 制作人的反应时间测量尺
name.en: Make a reaction-time ruler

textbookTitle.zh: 制作一个“人的反应时间测量尺”
textbookTitle.en: Make a reaction-time ruler

goal.zh: 由松尺到接尺的下落距离换算反应时间，并展示非均匀时间刻度。
goal.en: Convert a caught ruler’s falling distance to reaction time and construct its nonlinear time scale.

name.zh: 用悬挂法确定薄板的重心
name.en: Find a sheet’s centre of gravity by suspension

textbookTitle.zh: 用悬挂法确定薄板的重心
textbookTitle.en: Find a sheet’s centre of gravity by suspension

goal.zh: 更换悬点画铅垂线，以交点定位重心并检验三角形纸板。
goal.en: Change suspension points and intersect plumb lines to locate and check the centre of gravity.

name.zh: 观察物体的微小形变
name.en: Observe small deformations

textbookTitle.zh: 通过平面镜观察桌面的微小形变
textbookTitle.en: Observe small deformations

goal.zh: 用镜面转角和远处光点位移放大桌面形变，认识形变可以微小但非零。
goal.en: Amplify small table deformation through mirror rotation and a distant light spot.

name.zh: 探究弹簧弹力与形变量的关系
name.en: Investigate spring force and extension

textbookTitle.zh: 探究弹簧弹力与形变量的关系
textbookTitle.en: Investigate spring force and extension

goal.zh: 逐次加挂砝码，测原长及伸长并从F-x图像寻找弹性限度内的线性关系。
goal.en: Add masses, measure extension from the original length, and investigate linearity within the elastic range.

name.zh: 探究滑动摩擦力与压力的关系
name.en: Investigate sliding friction and normal force

textbookTitle.zh: 探究滑动摩擦力与压力的关系
textbookTitle.en: Investigate sliding friction and normal force

goal.zh: 水平匀速拉动木块，改变压力并比较测力计读数。
goal.en: Pull a block at steady speed, change normal load, and compare force readings.

name.zh: 静摩擦力的大小随拉力的变化
name.en: How static friction changes with applied force

textbookTitle.zh: 静摩擦力的大小随拉力的变化
textbookTitle.en: How static friction changes with applied force

goal.zh: 从静止到刚滑动，再到滑动，观察静摩擦自适应与最大静摩擦。
goal.en: Track adjustable static friction, its threshold, and the transition to sliding.

name.zh: 探究作用力和反作用力的关系
name.en: Investigate action and reaction forces

textbookTitle.zh: 用弹簧测力计探究作用力和反作用力的关系
textbookTitle.en: Investigate action and reaction forces

goal.zh: 在拉动或运动中比较两仪器同时读数，识别大小相等、方向相反且作用在不同物体上。
goal.en: Compare simultaneous paired readings during pulls and motion; identify equal opposite forces on different bodies.

name.zh: 探究两个互成角度的力的合成规律
name.en: Investigate the resultant of two angled forces

textbookTitle.zh: 探究两个互成角度的力的合成规律
textbookTitle.en: Investigate the resultant of two angled forces

goal.zh: 让两力与单力将橡皮条拉到相同位置，记录方向和大小，验证平行四边形关系。
goal.en: Match the rubber band’s endpoint under two forces and one force, then compare vector constructions.

name.zh: 伽利略双斜面理想实验
name.en: Galileo’s ideal double-incline experiment

textbookTitle.zh: 伽利略双斜面理想实验
textbookTitle.en: Galileo’s ideal double-incline experiment

goal.zh: 减小第二斜面倾角，比较回升高度与路程，推理无阻力水平极限。
goal.en: Lower the return incline, compare rise height and path length, and reason about the drag-free horizontal limit.

name.zh: 抽动纸张观察小钢球的运动
name.en: Observe a steel ball while pulling the paper beneath it

textbookTitle.zh: 惯性参考系
textbookTitle.en: Observe a steel ball while pulling the paper beneath it

goal.zh: 同时用桌面与加速纸面参考系观察同一球，区分惯性与非惯性参考系。
goal.en: Observe one ball from the table and accelerating paper to distinguish inertial and non-inertial frames.

title.zh: 实验：探究加速度与力、质量的关系

name.zh: 探究加速度与力、质量的关系
name.en: Investigate acceleration versus force and mass

textbookTitle.zh: 探究加速度与力、质量的关系
textbookTitle.en: Investigate acceleration versus force and mass

goal.zh: 控制质量或力，测加速度并检验a-F和a-1/m关系。
goal.en: Hold mass or force fixed, measure acceleration, and test a–F and a–1/m relationships.

name.zh: 用动力学方法测质量
name.en: Measure mass dynamically in space

textbookTitle.zh: 用动力学方法测质量
textbookTitle.en: Measure mass dynamically in space

goal.zh: 以恒力支架和光栅测速获得加速度，再由F/a测量失重中的质量。
goal.en: Use a constant-force support and optical velocity measurements to infer mass from F/a in weightlessness.

name.zh: 观察下蹲、站起过程中的超重和失重
name.en: Observe apparent weight during squatting and standing

textbookTitle.zh: 观察下蹲、站起过程中的超重和失重
textbookTitle.en: Observe apparent weight during squatting and standing

goal.zh: 把体重计读数变化对应到人体加速度，区分速度方向与加速度方向。
goal.en: Connect scale readings to body acceleration rather than velocity direction.

name.zh: 在电梯中观察体重计示数的变化
name.en: Observe scale readings in a moving lift

textbookTitle.zh: 在电梯中观察体重计示数的变化
textbookTitle.en: Observe scale readings in a moving lift

goal.zh: 比较电梯启动、匀速和制动时支持力的变化。
goal.en: Compare support force while the lift starts, cruises and brakes.

name.zh: 自由下落的漏水瓶：观察完全失重
name.en: A leaking bottle in free fall

textbookTitle.zh: 自由下落的漏水瓶：观察完全失重
textbookTitle.en: A leaking bottle in free fall

goal.zh: 对比静止漏水与自由下落时的水流，解释有效重力和液体压差的改变。
goal.en: Compare leaking at rest and in free fall through effective gravity and liquid pressure difference.

name.zh: 测量电梯的加速度
name.en: Measure a lift’s acceleration

textbookTitle.zh: 测量电梯的加速度
textbookTitle.en: Measure a lift’s acceleration

goal.zh: 以悬吊测力计或手机传感器测量加速度，并明确坐标方向与重力修正。
goal.en: Use a hanging force meter or a phone to measure lift acceleration with explicit axes and gravity correction.

name.zh: 球形物体空气阻力大小与速率关系的研究
name.en: Investigate a spherical object’s air drag versus speed

textbookTitle.zh: 球形物体空气阻力大小与速率关系的研究
textbookTitle.en: Investigate a spherical object’s air drag versus speed

goal.zh: 同一气球挂不同重物，通过视频等间距帧判断终端下落并拟合阻力与速率。
goal.en: Hang different loads from one balloon, identify terminal motion in video frames, and fit drag versus speed.

name.zh: 橡皮筋弹力与伸长量关系的研究
name.en: Investigate rubber-band force and extension

textbookTitle.zh: 橡皮筋弹力与伸长量关系的研究
textbookTitle.en: Investigate rubber-band force and extension

goal.zh: 测加载与卸载曲线，研究非线性、重复性与疲劳。
goal.en: Measure loading and unloading curves to investigate nonlinearity, repeatability and fatigue.

title.zh: 实验推动了物理学的发展

name.zh: 法拉第电磁感应实验
name.en: Faraday’s induction experiments

textbookTitle.zh: 法拉第电磁感应实验
textbookTitle.en: Faraday’s induction experiments

goal.zh: 把电磁感应发现作为实验推动理论的历史例证。
goal.en: Use induction as a historical example of experiments leading to theory.

title.zh: 实验推动了物理学的发展

name.zh: 赫兹验证电磁波存在的实验
name.en: Hertz’s demonstration of electromagnetic waves

textbookTitle.zh: 赫兹验证电磁波存在的实验
textbookTitle.en: Hertz’s demonstration of electromagnetic waves

goal.zh: 认识由理论预言到发射与接收实验检验的证据链。
goal.en: Connect the prediction of electromagnetic waves with emission-and-reception evidence.

title.zh: 实验推动了物理学的发展

name.zh: 吴健雄钴60实验：验证宇称不守恒
name.en: Wu’s cobalt-60 parity experiment

textbookTitle.zh: 吴健雄钴60实验：验证宇称不守恒
textbookTitle.en: Wu’s cobalt-60 parity experiment

goal.zh: 统计极化钴60衰变电子的方向分布，区分镜像对称假设与实验结果。
goal.en: Compare directional beta counts from polarized cobalt-60 with a parity-symmetric prediction.

title.zh: 实验推动了物理学的发展

name.zh: 韦伯铝棒引力波探测实验
name.en: Weber’s resonant-bar gravitational-wave experiment

textbookTitle.zh: 韦伯铝棒引力波探测实验
textbookTitle.en: Weber’s resonant-bar gravitational-wave experiment

goal.zh: 了解共振棒检测的原理与重复实验对证据可信度的重要性。
goal.en: Understand resonant-bar detection and the role of reproducibility.

title.zh: 实验推动了物理学的发展

name.zh: 双星轨道周期变化与引力波的间接观测
name.en: Binary-pulsar orbital decay as indirect gravitational-wave evidence

textbookTitle.zh: 双星轨道周期变化与引力波的间接观测
textbookTitle.en: Binary-pulsar orbital decay as indirect gravitational-wave evidence

goal.zh: 从脉冲计时推得轨道周期衰减，区分间接证据与直接探测。
goal.en: Infer orbital decay from pulse timing and distinguish indirect evidence from direct detection.

title.zh: 实验推动了物理学的发展

name.zh: 激光干涉仪直接探测引力波
name.en: Direct gravitational-wave detection with laser interferometers

textbookTitle.zh: 激光干涉仪直接探测引力波
textbookTitle.en: Direct gravitational-wave detection with laser interferometers

goal.zh: 由两臂相对长度变化观察干涉信号，并与后册LIGO历史重复位置相连。
goal.en: Connect differential arm-length changes with an interference signal and the later LIGO history passage.

name.zh: 用累积法测量铜丝直径
name.en: Measure wire diameter by accumulation

textbookTitle.zh: 用累积法测量铜丝直径
textbookTitle.en: Measure wire diameter by accumulation

goal.zh: 比较单根直径与密绕十圈总宽度，解释相对误差和有效数字。
goal.en: Compare one diameter with the width of ten turns to understand relative uncertainty and significant figures.

name.zh: 观察做曲线运动物体的速度方向
name.en: Observe velocity direction in curved motion

textbookTitle.zh: 观察做曲线运动物体的速度方向
textbookTitle.en: Observe velocity direction in curved motion

goal.zh: 让印泥钢球从不同弧形轨道出口离开，用印迹辨认切线速度。
goal.en: Release an ink-marked ball from different curved-track exits and identify tangent velocity.

name.zh: 观察钢球在磁力作用下的运动轨迹
name.en: Observe a steel ball’s path under magnetic attraction

textbookTitle.zh: 观察钢球的运动轨迹
textbookTitle.en: Observe a steel ball’s path under magnetic attraction

goal.zh: 改变磁铁相对速度方向的位置，比较直线加速与偏转轨迹。
goal.en: Move a magnet relative to the ball’s velocity and compare straight acceleration with deflection.

name.zh: 用飞镖显示曲线运动的速度方向
name.en: Use a dart to reveal the direction of motion

textbookTitle.zh: 用飞镖显示曲线运动的速度方向
textbookTitle.en: Use a dart to reveal the direction of motion

goal.zh: 用带尾翼飞镖的姿态辅助识别曲线轨迹各点速度方向。
goal.en: Use a finned dart’s orientation to reveal velocity direction along a curved trajectory.

name.zh: 观察蜡块的运动
name.en: Observe a rising wax block in a moving tube

textbookTitle.zh: 观察蜡块的运动
textbookTitle.en: Observe a rising wax block in a moving tube

goal.zh: 叠加蜡块上浮和玻璃管横移，比较匀速与匀加速横移下的合运动。
goal.en: Combine upward wax motion and horizontal tube motion, including constant and changing horizontal velocity.

title.zh: 实验：探究平抛运动的特点

name.zh: 探究平抛运动的特点
name.en: Investigate horizontal projectile motion

textbookTitle.zh: 探究平抛运动的特点
textbookTitle.en: Investigate horizontal projectile motion

goal.zh: 从等时记录、同时落地对照及描迹中分别检验水平和竖直分运动。
goal.en: Test horizontal and vertical components using equal-time records, paired drops and traced trajectories.

name.zh: 检验平抛运动的轨迹是不是抛物线
name.en: Test whether a projectile path is parabolic

textbookTitle.zh: 检验平抛运动的轨迹是不是抛物线
textbookTitle.en: Test whether a projectile path is parabolic

goal.zh: 利用上一节实测轨迹比较y与x²，避免凭曲线外形认定抛物线。
goal.en: Use the previous measured trace to test y against x² rather than judging by appearance.

name.zh: 用刻度尺测量钢球平抛的初速度
name.en: Measure horizontal launch speed with a ruler

textbookTitle.zh: 用刻度尺测量钢球平抛的初速度
textbookTitle.en: Measure horizontal launch speed with a ruler

goal.zh: 测桌高和水平落点距离，由飞行时间反推水平初速度。
goal.en: Measure table height and horizontal range to infer launch speed.

name.zh: 观察自行车齿轮的线速度和角速度
name.en: Compare linear and angular speeds on bicycle gears

textbookTitle.zh: 观察自行车齿轮的线速度和角速度
textbookTitle.en: Compare linear and angular speeds on bicycle gears

goal.zh: 比较不同齿轮啮合点的线速度与角速度，以及同轮不同半径点的线速度。
goal.en: Compare tangential and angular speeds across chain-connected gears and at different radii on one wheel.

name.zh: 剪断细线观察小球的运动
name.en: Observe a ball after cutting its string

textbookTitle.zh: 剪断细线观察小球的运动
textbookTitle.en: Observe a ball after cutting its string

goal.zh: 在约束消失的时刻保持原切向速度，区分向心力方向与运动方向。
goal.en: Preserve tangent velocity when the string constraint disappears, distinguishing force direction from motion.

name.zh: 感受向心力
name.en: Feel centripetal force

textbookTitle.zh: 感受向心力
textbookTitle.en: Feel centripetal force

goal.zh: 改变沙袋质量、转速及绳长，定性比较拉力，并保留重力下的锥摆倾角。
goal.en: Vary mass, rotation speed and string length while retaining the conical-pendulum effect of gravity.

name.zh: 探究向心力大小的表达式
name.en: Investigate the expression for centripetal force

textbookTitle.zh: 探究向心力大小的表达式
textbookTitle.en: Investigate the expression for centripetal force

goal.zh: 使用变速塔轮、槽中小球和弹簧套筒读数控制质量、半径、角速度。
goal.en: Use stepped pulleys, rotating balls and spring-sleeve readings to control mass, radius and angular speed.

name.zh: 观察小球沿漏斗壁做圆周运动
name.en: Observe a ball orbiting inside a funnel

textbookTitle.zh: 观察小球沿漏斗壁做圆周运动
textbookTitle.en: Observe a ball orbiting inside a funnel

goal.zh: 识别漏斗支持力水平分量提供向心力、竖直分量平衡重力。
goal.en: Resolve the funnel’s normal force into centripetal and weight-supporting components.

name.zh: 第谷的行星位置观测
name.en: Tycho’s observations of planetary positions

textbookTitle.zh: 第谷的行星位置观测
textbookTitle.en: Tycho’s observations of planetary positions

goal.zh: 用高精度位置记录约束轨道假说，呈现圆轨道残差促使开普勒修正模型。
goal.en: Use precise position records to constrain orbital hypotheses and expose circular-model residuals.

name.zh: 绘制椭圆
name.en: Draw an ellipse with pins and string

goal.en: Compare electron diffraction intensity with wavelength predictions as evidence for matter waves.

textbookTitle.en: Becquerel’s discovery of natural radioactivity

goal.zh: 对照曝光与暗处存放的铀盐底片，区分外部照射与物质自发发射。
goal.en: Compare uranium-salt photographic plates after illumination and dark storage to identify spontaneous emission.

goal.en: Compare ore radioactivity with known uranium and follow the evidence leading to new elements.

name.en: Separating alpha, beta and gamma radiation in a magnetic field

goal.zh: 对照三束射线的偏转方向和弯曲程度，联系电荷、质量与不带电射线。
goal.en: Compare deflection directions and curvature to distinguish charged alpha and beta radiation from neutral gamma rays.

textbookTitle.en: Observing particle tracks in a Wilson cloud chamber

goal.zh: 追踪活塞膨胀产生过饱和蒸气，观察离子沿粒子路径诱发凝结形成径迹。
goal.en: Follow expansion into supersaturation and condensation along ionized particle paths.

textbookTitle.en: Discovering the proton by bombarding nitrogen

goal.en: Track the longer-range particles produced by alpha bombardment of nitrogen as evidence of nuclear transmutation.

goal.en: Place the discovery of penetrating radiation in the history preceding radioactivity, separating evidence from later explanation.

goal.en: Compare ancient and modern carbon ratios and connect decay after exchange stops with an age estimate.

name.en: Discovering uranium fission by neutron bombardment

textbookTitle.en: Discovering uranium fission by neutron bombardment

name.en: Observing ternary and quaternary uranium fission

textbookTitle.zh: 钱三强、何泽慧发现铀核三分裂和四分裂
textbookTitle.en: Observing ternary and quaternary uranium fission

goal.zh: 比较常见两碎片与罕见三、四碎片事件，理解统计证据和小概率分支。

goal.en: Compare neutron multiplication and absorption control to distinguish a sustained controlled reaction from accelerating growth.

name.en: Discovering the Higgs boson at the LHC

textbookTitle.en: Discovering the Higgs boson at the LHC

goal.en: Understand discovery through statistical evidence across many events, rather than a direct photograph of a particle.
